# Vitrina

> > Vitrina is the global intelligence platform for film and TV production, distribution, financing, and supply chain partnerships.

Vitrina provides data-driven guides, market analysis, and strategic insights for entertainment professionals navigating content acquisition, VFX pipelines, co-production treaties, theatrical-streaming hybrid models, and regional distribution across markets including the United States, India, UAE, Southeast Asia, and Africa. The platform covers major players like Netflix, Paramount, Warner Bros, HBO, and emerging technologies including AI-driven VFX workflows.

## Key Topics

- Film distribution strategies
- Content acquisition models
- VFX studios and pipelines
- Co-production treaties
- Theatrical-streaming hybrid releases
- Film financing and presales
- Regional market dynamics (US, India, UAE, MENA, Southeast Asia, Africa)
- AI in visual effects
- OTT platforms and streaming strategy
- Independent filmmaking
- Production incentives and tax credits
- Rights negotiations and territorial deals
- Post-production workflows
- Entertainment supply chain
- Studio consolidation and M&A
